entities.summary: Rolf Milser is a retired German weightlifter. He competed at the 1972, 1976 and 1984 Olympics, missing the 1980 Games due to their boycott by West Germany, and won the gold medal in the heavyweight I class in 1984. Milser won two world titles and set two world records in the clean & jerk, in 1976 and 1979. He also won a European title in 1979.
